intent: Hold the placeholder's leading visual, either a small icon on a filled square plate or a bare illustration.
typical_uses: A single icon that names the kind of thing that is missing
An illustration or image that carries its own chrome

dont_use_when.situation: A person's or entity's picture with a fallback

invariants.text: `variant="icon"` draws a 3rem square plate with rounded corners, filled with var(--secondary), and sizes any descendant svg to var(--icon-size-lg); `variant="default"` adds no fill and no size, leaving the content at its own dimensions.
Any descendant svg of EmptyMedia gets pointer-events none and does not shrink, whichever variant is set.

anti_patterns.dont: Use `variant="icon"` around a full illustration or image
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep the default variant for anything larger than a glyph; the icon plate is a fixed 3rem square

good.title: A bare illustration with no plate

bad.title: An illustration placed on the icon plate
bad.why: The icon plate is a fixed 3rem (48px) square sized for a glyph, half the size of this image; the default variant leaves an illustration at its own dimensions.
